title: Unearned Days on FloodGuard Cancellations for Sale of the Property
content:
**Underwriting bulletin — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.** On a cancellation of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy the unearned share of the term turns on the cancellation reason stated on the request and, where the property was sold, on the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy at the same property address.

**Rule.** For a cancellation because the property was sold, when the customer's HomeGuard policy at the same property address ended within 7 days of the cancellation date, the cancellation date itself counts as unearned, so the share is the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date plus one, divided by the calendar days in the term. For a cancellation because the property was sold with no such HomeGuard corroboration, the unearned days run from the date the cancellation request was received, as recorded on the request whether or not it had been signed by then, to the expiration date, and are divided by the calendar days in the term. For every other cancellation the unearned days are the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date, divided by the calendar days in the term.

**Corroboration.** The HomeGuard Homeowners Policy read is the customer's policy at the same property address as the flood policy, and what is read is the date it ended. It corroborates the sale when that date falls no more than 7 calendar days before or after the cancellation date: an ending 7 days away corroborates, an ending 8 days away does not, and a HomeGuard policy at that address that has not ended does not corroborate.

| Reason stated on the request | HomeGuard at the same address ended within 7 days of the cancellation date | Unearned days | Divided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Property sold | Yes | From the cancellation date to the expiration date, plus one | Calendar days in the term |
| Property sold | No | From the date the request was received to the expiration date | Calendar days in the term |
| Any other reason | Not read | From the cancellation date to the expiration date | Calendar days in the term |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A term of 365 calendar days; a cancellation date 120 days before the expiration date; the request received 10 days after the cancellation date.

- Property sold, HomeGuard at the address ended 3 days after the cancellation date: 121 days over 365.
- Property sold, HomeGuard at the address ended 8 days before the cancellation date: counted from the date received, 110 days over 365.
- Loan paid off: 120 days over 365, whatever the HomeGuard policy shows.
